## Behaviour changes a consumer must handle

- `idb.remove` and `idb.flush` return a promise that rejects on failure. A call you do not await needs a `.catch`, or
  it becomes an unhandled rejection.
- `HttpClient` sends a string `body` as given, even under a JSON content-type; only a non-string body is
  JSON-encoded.
- A 2xx response with corrupt JSON rejects with `Error('API Layer: invalid JSON - <url>')` whose `cause` is the
  `SyntaxError`. An empty JSON body (204, 304) yields `''`.
- `HttpClient` requests and `poll` take a `signal`. Aborting rejects with the signal's reason (`AbortError` by
  default), unwrapped, and stops retries or polling.
- `usePortal` removes the mount point it created once its last user unmounts. One already in the page stays.
- A `Script` whose load failed retries it on the next mount of the same `src`.
